blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Subchapter F (子章節 F)： 21 CFR 第 21 篇（食品藥物）第 I 章（FDA 規範）下的子章節，專門規範「生物製品 (Biologics)」。其上位法律依據是《公共衛生服務法 (Public Health Service Act, PHS Act)》第 351 條，而非《聯邦食品藥物化妝品法 (FD&C Act)》——這是生物製品不同於一般藥品的法律起點。
blocks.en: Subchapter F: The subchapter of 21 CFR Title 21 (Food and Drugs), Chapter I (FDA), dedicated to regulating biologics. Its parent statute is Section 351 of the Public Health Service Act (PHS Act), not the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act). This is the legal starting point that distinguishes biological products from conventional drugs.

blocks.zh: 雙重合規義務 (Dual compliance)： 生物製品必須同時符合 Parts 600–680（生物製品特定要求）AND Parts 210/211（藥品 CGMP）。不是二選一，是兩者都要。
blocks.en: Dual compliance: A biological product must comply with both Parts 600–680 (biologics-specific requirements) AND Parts 210/211 (drug CGMP). It is not a choice between the two; both apply.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把法規體系比作建築法規：Parts 210/211 是「通用建築法規」（所有建築物都要遵守），Subchapter F 是「醫院專用附加規範」（在通用法規之上再加一層）。蓋醫院，兩本法規都得看。
blocks.en: Think of the regulatory system as building codes: Parts 210/211 are the "general building code" (every building must comply), while Subchapter F is the "hospital-specific supplement" (an additional layer on top of the general code). To build a hospital, you must follow both codebooks.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ★ Parts 600、601、610 是 CDMO 無菌充填操作的核心：600 管設施與偏差報告，601 管客戶 BLA 的許可變更，610 管每批次放行必須通過的品質測試三元素（無菌性、純度、效力）。
blocks.en: ★ Parts 600, 601 and 610 are the core of CDMO aseptic filling operations: Part 600 covers facilities and deviation reporting, Part 601 covers licensing changes to the client's BLA, and Part 610 covers the three elements of quality testing (sterility, purity, potency) that every batch must pass before release.

blocks.zh: ★ Parts 606–680（血液、診斷試劑、過敏原）對非血液製品 CDMO 幾乎不適用——但合約中仍應明確排除或限定適用範圍。
blocks.en: ★ Parts 606–680 (blood, diagnostic reagents, allergenics) are almost never applicable to a CDMO handling non-blood products, but the contract should still explicitly exclude them or limit their applicability.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 承接單株抗體（mAb）的充填包裝業務，需要符合哪幾個 Parts 的要求？
blocks.en: A CDMO takes on filling and packaging of a monoclonal antibody (mAb). Which Parts' requirements must it meet?

blocks.zh: 為什麼生物製品的 BLA（生物製品許可申請）和藥品的 NDA（新藥申請）分別由不同中心（CBER vs CDER）審查？
blocks.en: Why are BLAs (biologics license applications) for biological products and NDAs (new drug applications) for drugs reviewed by different centers (CBER vs CDER)?

blocks.zh: 0.2 Definition: What Is a Biological Product? 0.2 定義：何謂生物製品？
blocks.en: 0.2 Definition: What Is a Biological Product?

blocks.zh: 40 胺基酸門檻的重要性： 2020 年 FDA 最終規則明確將「蛋白質 (protein)」定義為 >40 個胺基酸的聚合物。這意味著大多數單株抗體（mAb, ~1300 AA）、胰島素（51 AA，略超門檻）、重組蛋白等都受 Subchapter F 規範。
blocks.en: Why the 40-amino-acid threshold matters: The FDA's 2020 final rule expressly defines a "protein" as a polymer of more than 40 amino acids. This means most monoclonal antibodies (mAb, ~1300 AA), insulin (51 AA, just above the threshold), recombinant proteins and similar products fall under Subchapter F.

blocks.zh: 監管移轉歷史： 2020 年前，許多蛋白質類藥品（如胰島素）曾由 CDER 以 NDA 方式審查。2020 年 3 月 23 日起，依 BPCIA（生物製品價格競爭與創新法）自動轉移為 BLA 管轄，需要新的生物製品許可。
blocks.en: History of the regulatory transition: Before 2020, many protein drugs (such as insulin) were reviewed by CDER under NDAs. Beginning March 23, 2020, under the BPCIA (Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act), they were automatically transitioned to BLA jurisdiction and required a new biologics license.

blocks.zh: 把 40 胺基酸門檻想成「尺寸限制」——就像某些交通工具因尺寸需要商業駕照，超過 40 AA 的蛋白質藥品需要「BLA 許可」而非一般的 NDA。
blocks.en: Think of the 40-amino-acid threshold as a "size limit": just as some vehicles need a commercial driver's license because of their size, protein drugs above 40 AA need a "BLA license" rather than an ordinary NDA.

blocks.zh: ★ CDMO 承接 mAb 充填、重組蛋白製劑、疫苗充填，客戶持有的是 BLA（不是 NDA）。CDMO 的合約製造合約必須支援 BLA 相關的合規義務（偏差報告 45 天、製程變更事先批准等）。
blocks.en: ★ When a CDMO takes on mAb filling, recombinant protein formulations or vaccine filling, the client holds a BLA (not an NDA). The CDMO's contract manufacturing agreement must support BLA-related compliance obligations (45-day deviation reporting, prior approval of process changes, etc.).

blocks.zh: ★ 組合產品（Combination products）若以生物製品為主要作用模式（primary mode of action），同樣受 BLA 規範。
blocks.en: ★ Combination products whose primary mode of action is that of a biological product are likewise subject to BLA regulation.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: Amaran 承接某客戶的 PD-1 單株抗體充填業務——這個產品是蛋白質（>40 AA）、用於治療，必然是生物製品，客戶持有 BLA。Amaran 作為合約製造商，必須在 600.14 偏差報告機制、601.12 製程變更協議、610.12 無菌性測試驗證等方面，確保 SOP 和品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 都與客戶 BLA 承諾一致。
blocks.en: Amaran takes on filling of a client's PD-1 monoclonal antibody. The product is a protein (>40 AA) used for treatment, so it is necessarily a biological product, and the client holds the BLA. As the contract manufacturer, Amaran must ensure that its SOPs and Quality Agreement are consistent with the client's BLA commitments on the 600.14 deviation reporting mechanism, the 601.12 process change agreement, and the 610.12 sterility test validation.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Subchapter F (Parts 600–680) 是 FDA 生物製品完整法規框架，上位法為 PHS Act § 351
blocks.en: 21 CFR Subchapter F (Parts 600–680) is the FDA's complete regulatory framework for biological products, with PHS Act § 351 as its parent statute

blocks.zh: 生物製品必須同時符合 Subchapter F（生物製品特定規範）AND Parts 210/211（藥品 CGMP）
blocks.en: Biological products must comply with both Subchapter F (biologics-specific requirements) AND Parts 210/211 (drug CGMP)

blocks.zh: 對無菌充填 CDMO 最關鍵的是 Parts 600（設施/偏差）、601（BLA/變更）、610（批次放行三元素）
blocks.en: For an aseptic filling CDMO, the most critical Parts are 600 (facilities/deviations), 601 (BLA/changes) and 610 (the three elements of batch release)

blocks.zh: 蛋白質定義（>40 胺基酸）使大多數 mAb 和重組蛋白都受 BLA 管轄，影響 CDMO 合約義務
blocks.en: The protein definition (>40 amino acids) places most mAbs and recombinant proteins under BLA jurisdiction, affecting CDMO contractual obligations
